title: Travel to school by grade
stem: A student asks 150 randomly chosen students how they usually travel to school. A χ² test for independence is carried out at the 5% significance level.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: State the null and alternative hypotheses.
markscheme: H₀: method of travel is independent of grade
H₁: method of travel is not independent of grade / depends on grade

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Show that the expected frequency of Grade 11 students who walk is 23.3, correct to 3 significant figures.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Write down the number of degrees of freedom.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Calculate the χ² statistic and the p-value.

parts.label: e
parts.prompt: State the conclusion of the test, giving a reason.
markscheme: do not reject H₀: insufficient evidence that travel method depends on grade
parts.notes: Reason required for the conclusion mark. Do not accept “H₀ is proved true”.

title: Revision time and test score
stem: Eight students recorded the number of hours, x, they revised for a test and their score, y, out of 100.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find Pearson’s product-moment correlation coefficient, r.
markscheme: use of GDC with correct data

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Write down the equation of the regression line of y on x.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Use your equation to estimate the score of a student who revised for 7 hours.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Explain why the equation should not be used to estimate the score of a student who revised for 30 hours.
markscheme: 30 hours is outside the data range (2–12) / extrapolation; the model would predict over 100

title: Calls to a help desk
stem: The number of calls arriving at a help desk is modelled by a Poisson distribution with a mean of 4.5 calls per hour.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the probability that exactly 3 calls arrive in a given hour.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the probability that at least 6 calls arrive in a given hour.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the probability that at most 7 calls arrive in a 2-hour period.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: After a website change, a manager records 9 calls in one hour and claims the mean rate has increased. Test this claim at the 5% significance level, stating your hypotheses.
markscheme: 0.0403 < 0.05 so reject H₀: evidence the rate has increased

parts.label: e
parts.prompt: State what a Type I error would mean in this context.
markscheme: concluding the call rate has increased when it is actually still 4.5 per hour
